objects.name: Vic Viper

frames.name: level
frames.source: two sprites at the same (E204,E206); sprite 1 = white body, sprite 2 = red detail

objects.notes: The ship has no animation: the drawing is a function of the up/down joystick bits. Sprite 1 (pattern 00/10/08, colour 15) is uploaded first so it has priority over sprite 2. The TwinBee-cartridge variant is catalogued separately (n1.player.twinbee_combo, excluded).

objects.name: Vic Viper shield (barrier)

frames.name: full_shield_A (E200=3, level/up)
frames.source: sprite 2 is drawn 8 px right of the ship (p03:$A1A5 adds 8 to the X)

objects.notes: With the shield up the second ship sprite (red detail) is replaced by the shield pattern; the nose-up ship uses the level body (pattern 00). The barrier damage states are: full (patterns 2C/30, 24/28 when diving) and weak (3C/40, 34/38). Offsets corrected from the earlier pass (it had the shield 8 px lower): p03:$A1A5 adds 8 to the X; the captures show the shield sprite at ship X+8, same Y (main_route t0027-t0030).

objects.name: Vic Viper death explosion
objects.notes: The two ship sprites become explosion patterns; the two option slots become debris patterns.

screens.name: Konami logo ("Konami" + SOFTWARE)
screens.how_shown: At power-on and after each attract cycle: mode 0 (p00:$52D7 estado_0) clears the screen, loads the text font, decompresses the logo and raises it one row per call from row 21 to row 7, then writes the message.
screens.graphics_source: p00:$5A54 presentacion: RLE stream p00:$5A9A -> VRAM $6200 (chars 0x40.. of the three thirds), colours 0xF0 for 0xD8 bytes from $0200; p00:$5A68 sube_el_logotipo writes 3+12+12 chars from 0x40 per row; p00:$52E2 compressed message p00:$57BD (12 x char 0x5A underline at row 10, "SOFTWARE" at row 11 col 12); font p00:$5851 carga_el_marcador.
screens.notes: Static build equals the emulator VRAM for every byte the routines write (tools/screens.py compare_written).

screens.name: Title screen, Japanese machines (GRADIUS)

screens.graphics_source: p00:$5B31 monta_la_pantalla_del_titulo: bank9 $9C57 -> $2468 (patterns) and bank9 $9EAB -> $0468 (colours), three thirds; p00:$5B77 panel of 5 rows x 28 chars from bank9 $9BCB at row 4 col 2; p00:$57EB messages "(c)KONAMI 1986", "PLAY SELECT", "1PLAYER", "2PLAYERS"; cursor ship chars 1B 1C (p00:$581D) blinking (p00:$5BD3 parpadea_lo_elegido).
code_refs: p00:$5506 vuelta_de_los_estados (fire starts, other keys toggle 1/2 players)

screens.name: Presentation picture with sprites
screens.how_shown: Attract mode, mode 2 (p00:$5312 estado_2): after the title wait, before the demo.
screens.graphics_source: p00:$5BF8 (called "pantalla de records" by the disassembly): bank9 six RLE blocks $8300/$87FA/$8CB2 -> patterns $2008/$2808/$3008, $917E/$9515/$989F -> colours $0008/$0808/$1008; bank10 $A758/$A783 -> chars 0xF0.. of the three thirds; sprites bank10 $A7A4 -> $1800; the 768-byte name table bank9 $8000 copied raw; bank10 $A809/$A88D sprite engine (n1.effect.presentation_sprites); seven name-table star records bank10:$A849 copied to RAM $E710 and animated with chars F6-F8 by p03:$BDD2 (n1.scenery.presentation_twinkle).
screens.notes: Hidden developer names (TCRF): "NAOKI" and "YUTAKA" are drawn in the picture at the lower right, name-table rows 22-23 cols 28-31 (chars B8-BB and D0-D4 of the bank-9 set). There is no separate staff roll in the cartridge. Static build against capture a_ms0020000: 86 bytes differ, all written by p03:$BDD2 (the colour entries of chars F6-F8 in the three thirds and the seven twinkle cells with the cell below each).

screens.name: Demo (recorded joystick)
screens.how_shown: Attract mode after the presentation: p00:$5C88 arranca_la_demo starts stage E006 (cycles 1..8), fully powered (p03:$A0D8, like HYPER), and p00:$5CBE feeds the recorded joystick (bank 12, pairs [frames][value]) with fire held.

screens.notes: Captured: only the stage-1 demo of the first attract cycle. The demos of stages 2-8 set up their stage with the normal loader (p00:$5CB5 calls monta_la_fase_que_toque), so their graphics are the stage graphics captured in play.

screens.name: Game over ("GAME OVER" / "CONTINUE F5")
screens.how_shown: Mode 6 (p00:$546F) with no ships left: sound 0xCA, then mode 7 (p00:$54D9) writes the message and waits for the sound to end; F5 continues.

screens.name: Continue (F5 during game over)
screens.how_shown: p00:$54F3: F5 (keyboard row 7 bit 1) sets E06F and erases "CONTINUE F5"; when the sound ends the score is cleared, three ships are given and the stage restarts (mode 4).
screens.graphics_source: p00:$5500 borra_caracteres(p00:$5843) erases row 12; then the stage-start screen.
screens.notes: No counter or limit: continuing is always allowed.

gaps.summary: Every sprite and every character cell in the 9193 emulator dumps maps to a catalogued object, to the stage terrain script or to a screen built from the ROM (coverage.json: 0 unmapped). The entries below are what is excluded, what is proven by code only, and what the code shows does not exist.

excluded_by_owner_decision.reason: TwinBee cartridge (RC-740) combination. Catalogued from code (p00:$505A sets F0F4, p00:$428A loads bank5:$9963 over the sprite table, p02:$998C picks the ship tables $9A25/$9A67); not run in the emulator because it needs the second cartridge.
Same combination: p00:$4326 loads the char records bank5:$938E (capsule chars 0x77-0x7E) and, from stage 9, bank5:$939B (bonus item chars 0x80-0x87). Catalogued from code, not run in the emulator.

frames_not_observed_in_emulator.proof: code only (frame rendered from the ROM)
frames_not_observed_in_emulator.reason: Weak shield (E200=2) while diving, non-blink phase (record p02:$99FF). The blink phase of the same posture and the other weak-shield records were captured; no dump fell on this one.

frames_not_observed_in_emulator.proof: code only (frame rendered from the ROM)
frames_not_observed_in_emulator.reason: Needs a marked type 0D (colour 6, p01:$6B19) to be destroyed in stage 7; the stage-7 runs only destroyed unmarked ones in the dumped frames.

frames_not_observed_in_emulator.proof: code only (frame rendered from the ROM)
frames_not_observed_in_emulator.reason: Hit drawing of the stage-7 hatch (drawing +1 for the frames after a hit); the stage-7 hatches were dumped only in their normal drawing.

frames_not_observed_in_emulator.proof: code only (frame rendered from the ROM)
frames_not_observed_in_emulator.reason: Heaviest damage state of the stage-6 boss body (life below 0x10, p01:$77F3); not on screen in any dump (the stage-6 runs were dumped once per second).

frames_not_observed_in_emulator.proof: code only (frame rendered from the ROM)
frames_not_observed_in_emulator.reason: The frame lists the whole font. Every char was seen on screen except 0x20 (the first glyph of p00:$596E) and 0x2A, 0x31, 0x38, 0x3A (J, Q, X, Z): no message shown in the captures uses them.

proven_by_code_only.reason: Never drawn: p00:$4850 treats type 0x19 as an empty slot, so there is no picture to capture. What it turns into when the ship touches it (p01:$74E8) is n1.item.oneup or n1.item.bonus_capsule, both captured.

Only the stage-1 demo of the first attract cycle was dumped. p00:$5C88 cycles E006 over stages 1-8 and sets each stage up with the normal loader (p00:$5CB5), so the graphics are those captured in play.

proven_by_code_only.item: ending texts GOOD/NICE/FINE/GREAT and the loop-5 texts
proven_by_code_only.reason: Captured by poking the loop counter E070 (0-4) before the stage-8 boss, not by playing five loops. The text streams p00:$4FF4-$502E are chosen only by E070 and the region nibble (BIOS 0x002B).
openMSX here has no C-BIOS_MSX1_EU system ROM; C-BIOS_MSX1 (international) was used. The cartridge only tests whether the region nibble is 0 (Japan) or not, so Europe shows the international screens.

p01:$62DC reads the stage script pointer from p01:$64FA + 2*stage; for stage 12 that word is 0x00B4, past the end of the table, so the script is read from the BIOS ROM at 0x00B4. With C-BIOS no E700 object appeared in the 309 stage-12 dumps; with a real MSX BIOS the bytes differ and the result was not tested.

Known bug (disassembly docs/FINDINGS.md): the checkpoint table p00:$4214 has eleven entries and stage 12 reads 0xBACD from code at p00:$422A, so it always restarts at distance 0x20. No graphics involved.

sound.reason: Has its own stream (bank7:$8482, about 0.5 s) but no request site, type table or music list gives the number 7: never requested (music.json).
From running the cartridge engine on each request, not from timing the emulator audio; the disassembly docs compare its PSG writes with openMSX frame by frame for 0x32 and 0x16 only.

explained_screen_content_that_is_not_an_.reason: The new stage character set is loaded but the name table still holds the previous map for one frame (seen once, stage 11, 123 cells).

explained_screen_content_that_is_not_an_.item: play field left under the stage-start, game-over and continue messages
explained_screen_content_that_is_not_an_.reason: Those screens only clear the rows they write; the stage-1 map and a fan stay in the name table (coverage.json labels them "still on screen").

The stage loader does not clear the pattern and colour tables, so chars it does not write keep the previous screen's data (for example the third-0/1 chars at stage start). No catalogued object uses them in that stage.
p00:$44E7 only stops the game; no graphic or text is drawn.

not_present_in_the_code.reason: No credits screen exists. The only names are "NAOKI" and "YUTAKA", hidden in the presentation picture (name-table rows 22-23, cols 28-31), catalogued in n1.screen.presentation.
No such screens: the mode machine p00:$52C4 has eight states (p00:$52C7 table: logo, title, attract, play start, stage start, play, game over, continue) and none of them draws one.

screens.name: Power-on blank screen
screens.how_shown: State 0 step 0 (0xE1C0=0, 0xE1C1=0) right after reset: blank name table, backdrop colour set through VDP register 7.
screens.graphics_source: no graphics: name table cleared (p00:4A10 borra_nombres), border colour via p00:5D25 color_de_fondo

screens.name: Konami logo
screens.how_shown: State 0 steps 1-2: the KONAMI logo appears one pixel row at a time on a blue backdrop, then waits.
screens.graphics_source: p09:B79F (RLE p00:4A8C) logo characters from 0x40, 21 x 6 characters on row 8 (p01:6237 logo_de_konami); rows revealed in colour 0xF0 by p01:626B logo_aparece

screens.name: Title logo build-up
screens.how_shown: State 0 step 3: the game logo is decompressed to the RAM screen and shown in steps (fades) before the title texts.
screens.graphics_source: logo image p10:B832 (GRADIUS 2, Japanese MSX: 0x002B low nibble 0) or p10:B7A1 (NEMESIS 2, other MSX) via p10:B636 logo_del_titulo at 0x3843 (26 columns); step data p10:B8E6/B8D7 (p10:B64F); title characters p00:55A7 list and, outside Japan, p12:AA83/AA96 (p01:615B)

screens.name: Title screen (PLAY SELECT)
screens.how_shown: State 1 (and any key during states 0-2, p00:5A3E mandos_del_titulo): logo, (C)KONAMI 1987, PLAY SELECT, 1PLAYER / 2PLAYERS with a blinking arrow cursor; the logo alternates two pictures every 4 frames (p10:B77C). Times out to the demo (state 2).
screens.graphics_source: texts p10:B904 (:KONAMI 1987 / PLAY SELECT / 1PLAYER) and p10:B92B (2PLAYERS) in the main font (p11:B6CD); cursor characters p03:B26F (p01:61EC); title sprites p12:AA75 -> 0x1800 (p01:6198) with positions p10:B8FC; colours p12:B8F5 (p10:A24C)

screens.name: Story prologue text (Japanese MSX only)
screens.how_shown: State 2 (demo) starts the story (p10:A643 empieza_historia): on a Japanese MSX (0x002B low nibble 0) step 1 shows this text page first; other machines start at scene 1 (step 2).
screens.graphics_source: text list p10:A8B9 in the story font (p00:5E20: p09:AFF8, p12:BC09, p12:BEF1)
screens.notes: Not shown on the international machine (EN capture starts at story step 2).

screens.name: Story scene 1: the coup
screens.how_shown: Story step 2 (0xE1D7=2, p10:A088 escena_1) during the demo state 2; next scenes are paced by the interrupt counter 0xF0F7.
screens.graphics_source: image p10:ACAB (27 columns at 0x3843, p10:A67B pinta_imagen) with characters p09:A16D (+ mirror p09:A174, upside-down p09:A187); text p10:A933 (Japanese) or p10:B151 (DR.VENOM THE DIRECTOR GENERAL...)

screens.name: Story scene 2: Venom exiled
screens.how_shown: Story step 4 (p10:A0C5 escena_2).
screens.graphics_source: image p10:ADBD (21 columns at 0x3866); while waiting, two pieces p10:B0AB/B0B1 alternate every 8 frames at 0x38EC (p10:A0FA); text p10:A981 or p10:B1AA

screens.name: Story scene 3: escape from Sard
screens.how_shown: Story step 6 (p10:A124 escena_3).
screens.graphics_source: three images p10:AE67 (14 columns at 0x382E), p10:AE96 (8 at 0x3902), p10:AEA8 (6 at 0x394A) with characters p12:B223 (p01:6A0F); text p10:A9CD or p10:B214

screens.name: Story scene 4: Metalion schematic / search
screens.how_shown: Story step 8 (p10:A177 escena_4).

screens.name: Story scenes 6-7: the invader was Dr. Venom
screens.how_shown: Story steps 12-17: p10:A207 escena_6 writes the text; p10:A2C5 escena_7 decompresses the big picture p10:AEBD to the RAM screen 0xED00 and reveals it row by row (p10:A35D, p10:A386, fades p10:B0B7/B0CB), then p10:A3C7 removes it and writes the second text.
screens.graphics_source: characters p10:AB02 (p10:A242) and p09:A18B (+ copies p09:A204); picture p10:AEBD (23 columns); texts p10:AAB4 / p10:B332 and p10:AAD9 / p10:B34E

screens.graphics_source: map image p10:AF6D (23 columns at 0x3885); light characters p10:A4DF ([char][column][row]); texts p10:AB2E / p10:B39F, Japanese only p10:AB72 and p10:ABD1

screens.name: Play screen with HUD
screens.how_shown: State 5: the bottom row holds lives, 1P score, HI score and the power meter (see n2.hud.* objects).
screens.graphics_source: HUD texts p03:B23D (p00:5BA3 pinta_el_marcador), digits/letters p11:B736 fuente_del_marcador, meter p00:53F9 labels p14:9BD3

screens.name: Pause
screens.how_shown: F1 during play (p00:58FD state 9): the game freezes, no pause text is drawn; the keyboard buffer for the second-cartridge keywords is read here (p03:BD7C).
screens.graphics_source: none (frozen play screen)

screens.name: GAME OVER / CONTINUE F5 / HI SCORE and code
screens.how_shown: State 7 when lives run out: (PLAYER n with two players) GAME OVER and CONTINUE F5 (F5 sets 0xE20C and continues with score 0 and 3 lives, p00:5942); with no cartridge in the other slot the HI SCORE, the record and a four-digit code computed from it are shown (p00:5C12).
screens.graphics_source: texts p03:B288 (GAME  OVER / CONTINUE  F5), p03:B295 erased on F5, p03:B2A0; record and code p00:5C12 record_y_codigo with p12:BBB9
screens.notes: The continue prompt is part of this screen (kind continue is covered here). The HI SCORE code is the only ranking-like display; there is no name entry.

screens.name: Boss destroyed (dissolve)
screens.how_shown: In play after a boss core is destroyed: the boss characters dissolve (p11:A2A2 via p01:7438 suceso_final).
screens.graphics_source: boss characters being erased by p11:A2A2

screens.name: Boss interior ending: YOU CAPTURED
screens.how_shown: End of each boss interior (stage 8, 0xE3C0 steps 1-12, p01:74A2): the ship is moved to the centre, the gate opens (p01:7738) and blinks (p01:7758), the core animates (p01:7565), YOU CAPTURED (p01:7725 with letters p11:B77F) and the prize 0xE444: one weapon (step 8), two weapons (steps 9-11, second label at 0x3498) or NOTHING (p01:7731); then the ship leaves (p11:A2A2).
screens.graphics_source: character drawings p01:7738, p01:7758, p01:7565; texts p01:7725, p01:7731; weapon labels p14:9BD3 (p01:7690 arma_capturada)
screens.notes: The NOTHING and single-weapon prizes were not captured (the autopilot forced 0xE444 = 2).

screens.name: Between stages
screens.how_shown: State 8 after a stage, interior or the stage-7 interlude: p00:58CF estado_8_vuelve calls p01:7C1C siguiente_fase (next stage, interior after a boss), repaints HUD and meter; the R.DRILL turns back into the ship.
screens.graphics_source: play field cleared; HUD

screens.name: Interlude after stage 7: EMERGENCY, return to Nemesis
screens.how_shown: State 10 with 0xE1D6 = 0 (after the stage-7 boss, p01:7BEA final_del_juego): ending steps from p10:BB7B. Japan: cockpit picture with texts p14:9222 every 300 frames, blinking warning p14:94C4, star-map scene p14:9317 with texts p14:9281, route lights and text p14:9361, then back to play for the return trip (step 9 p10:BACD). Elsewhere: cockpit and DR. VENOM IS FAST APPROACHING NEMESIS! RETURN IMMEDIATELY! (p14:94D1) blinking while the music plays (p10:BA9C), then back to play.
screens.graphics_source: cockpit picture p14:91A8 (18 columns at 0x38A7) with characters p12:A000 (+ copies p12:A00D) and colours 0x80 (p10:BBE0 imagen_del_final_1); texts p14:9222, p14:94C4, p14:9281, p14:9317, p14:9361 (Japan), p14:94D1 (international)

screens.name: Ending (after the final core, stage 0)
screens.how_shown: State 10 with 0xE1D6 set (stage-0 core destroyed, p01:7A4C guion_fase_0): p10:BBAC final_de_verdad. Japan: step 9 eyes picture, step 10 texts p14:93B4 every 480 frames, step 11 hangar picture with text p14:950F, fade, step 13 final text p10:BC85. Elsewhere: step 11 hangar picture with OPERATIONS TO ERADICATE VENOM WERE ACHIEVED BY METALION... (p10:BC23), fade, final text p10:BD1A (COSMIC YEAR 6667 ... WRITTEN BY EMPEROR LARS THE 18TH). Step 14 waits until frame 0x1518.
screens.graphics_source: eyes picture p10:B06F (16 columns at 0x38E8) with characters p09:A143 (p10:BC02 imagen_del_final_2); hangar picture p10:B586 (p10:A56F escena_piloto_b, characters p10:BFCA); texts p14:93B4, p14:950F, p10:BC85 (Japan), p10:BC23, p10:BD1A (international); story font p00:5E20

screens.name: THE END / SEE YOU NEXT....
screens.how_shown: State 10 sub-steps after the ending (p00:5955): step 2 clears the screen and writes THE END and - EXTEND F5 - (p03:B2AF); without F5 for 600 frames the prompt becomes SEE YOU NEXT.... (p03:B2DB) and the game ends (state 0).
screens.graphics_source: texts p03:B2AF, p03:B2BA, p03:B2DB in the story font

screens.name: THE END - EXTEND F5 - (play the next loop)
screens.how_shown: State 10 step 3 (p00:5981): - EXTEND F5 - is offered; with F5 PUSH SPACE KEY (p03:B2CA) appears, with SPACE LET'S START (p03:B2EE) and the game goes on to the next loop (state 8).
screens.graphics_source: texts p03:B2AF (THE END / - EXTEND F5 -), p03:B2CA (PUSH SPACE KEY), p03:B2EE (LET'S START)
screens.notes: PUSH SPACE KEY and LET'S START (after F5) were decoded from the ROM but not captured (F5 was not pressed in the ending runs).

screens.name: Font: main letters and digits
screens.how_shown: Title, demo title, game start, PLAYER n, GAME OVER, HUD: p11:B6CD fuente_tres_tercios (also p11:B6F0 two thirds, p11:B736 HUD bottom third).
screens.graphics_source: digits p11:B7B4 (0x68 bytes -> characters 0x10-0x1C), letters p11:B81C (0xD8 bytes -> characters 0x20-0x3A), colours 0xF0
screens.notes: Rendered from the ROM bytes (white on dark); the colour table is filled with 0xF0 by the loader.

screens.name: Font: story and ending (kana, kanji, Latin)
screens.how_shown: Story, interlude after stage 7, ending and THE END screens: p00:5E20 caracteres_del_final.
screens.graphics_source: p09:AFF8 (0x3D8 bytes -> characters 0x26-0xA0), p12:BC09 (0x2E8 bytes -> characters 0xA1-0xFD), p12:BEF1 (0x28 bytes -> characters 0x21-0x25), three thirds, colours 0xF0
screens.notes: Rendered from the ROM bytes (white on dark); the colour table is filled with 0xF0 by the loader.

gaps.reason: Needs the Penguin Adventure cartridge in the other slot (0xF0F5 bit 2, p03:$BCB1). Catalogued from p03:$A879/$A881 and p12:$BF19/$BF82 (sprites), p11:$BF63/$BFBF (characters), marked "excluded": "owner decision"; not run in the emulator.

Other second-cartridge features are catalogued but not excluded (the brief excludes only Penguin Adventure/Pentarou for Nemesis 2) and were not run with the real cartridge: Maze of Galious keeps the equipment and offers the BACK UP meter box (label 1 of p14:$9BD3, p02:$8E7C, p01:$7DD9); Q*bert enables the pause keywords LARS18TH/NEMESIS/METALION (p03:$BD7C, words p03:$BEB0); METALION gives the untouchable colour 3 (0xE446) frame of n2.player.metalion. None of them was run with the cartridge; the keywords were not typed.

Types with a ficha in p00:$4F45 (and dispatch entries) but no spawn list, wave or code path creating them was found; catalogued from the ficha only and never seen in the emulator (records of these types appear only when 0xE600 is used as scratch at transitions). Their ficha picture is rendered with the map_01 set; for 0A, 12 and 1E the ficha pattern is not even loaded there (flagged in the frame checks).
Boss piece drawings 0x1D/0x1F of p09:$BB01 are not selected by any boss record; special capsule classes 1, 2 and 6 (p08:$9094) are not placed by any capsule list. Catalogued from the tables.

Types 0x3B/0x3C are created only when type 0x0F (stage 5 / return trip) is hit by LASER or EXTEND LASER (p02:$9809, p02:$985F). The capture runs never had a laser on screen while 0x0F was hit. Catalogued from code.

Type 0x2B (1UP) only comes from two hidden blocks of stage 10 (block list p15:$A14D: columns 0x0B8 and 0x124, C = 2 -> invisible type 0x2E that becomes 0x28 + C + 1 = 0x2B when hit, p01:$72AC, p02:$89E8). The autopilot never hit them, so it was not seen. Catalogued from p00:$5265 and p02:$96AA tipo_2b_empieza.

Decoded but not captured: interior prize NOTHING (p01:$7731) and the single-weapon prize (0xE3C0 step 8) because the autopilot forced 0xE444 = 2; PUSH SPACE KEY (p03:$B2CA) and LET'S START (p03:$B2EE) after F5 at THE END. No staff roll exists: the ending step table p10:$B99A has 14 steps (texts, pictures, the pilot scene the disassembly calls creditos) and no list of names; there is no name entry (only the HI SCORE code, p00:$5C12) and no password or option screen; stages start without a title card (p01:$6128 empieza_la_fase).

In stage 5 the first frames of type 0x11 use sprite pattern F0 (p08:$9902), which the stage-5 set does not load: the real VRAM shows whatever the previous stage left there (the map_05 F0/8 byte mismatches of gap.vram_checks). The catalogue frame [map_05 first frame F0] is rendered with the stage-5 table and flagged in its checks.

Ship patterns 00/15 and 04/8 mismatch in a few samples at the death (p00:$42DD has already replaced the patterns with the explosion pictures while the SAT still shows the ship) and on the first R.DRILL frame (p00:$42FE). One-frame transitions, not missing objects.

Positions computed at run time are not fixed frames: the four sprites of the 0x38 snake trail each other (offsets vary), the stage-1 rotator draws a 14-row strip from a start row given by its direction, falling pieces are drawn at the map position they leave. The catalogue gives the drawings; the emulator proof matched them in the recorded name tables / SAT.
Breakable characters (p02:$8481) are stage map characters; the proof only matched the 2x2 A0 block of stage 9 in the recorded name tables. The breaking itself was not checked frame by frame.
The 25 meter label drawings come from p14:$9BD3 by index; their names in the frame list are the text the drawings show (the labels are pictures of text, not encoded strings).

Catalogued without frames or PNG because the code gives them no drawing: type 0x21 has an all-zero ficha and no creator; class 4 (pod launcher) is skipped by the drawing routine p01:$6000 (the pods come out of the map characters).

stage_map.json: the per-type parameter B of the enemy list (IX+19) and the turret facing index are given raw, not translated into pictures or paths; the stage-0 wave (type 0x0B) and the level-10 filler nibbles were never active in the captures (level stayed below 10); the loop after EXTEND F5 (second loop) was not played to its end in the emulator. Spawn tables were decoded for every stage and checked against the enemy types recorded in play: no recorded type is unexplained (stage_map.md, Emulator check).

series_name is filled only where the game or the disassembly docs name the object (Metalion, Force Field, Option, weapon labels, Power Capsule...). The docs give no enemy or boss names, so enemies and bosses have series_name null.
All objects with an empty capture_proof (each is explained above).
0 sprite (pattern, colour) pairs and 0 character-drawn records seen in the emulator are not mapped to a catalogued object.

Sprite pattern bytes in the VRAM samples that differ from the catalogue tables (see gap.map05_type11_pattern_F0 and gap.transient_sprite_frames), and stage characters that differ (animated characters and the star characters FE/FF only).

Boss pieces come from the data blocks (p11:$A7C6), the static piece tables of each boss and the values seen in 0xECE3-0xECF3; the placement of the parts on screen is not rebuilt as a matrix (see the boss captures). Bosses 3/6 load their chars progressively (p00:$4763); the PNG uses the full set.

Scenery piece shapes/sizes are the values the piece code wrote in the runs (write census); shapes a piece can take only in situations not met are missing. Piece names are descriptive, not from the cartridge.
Its creation frame shows record pattern 0x50, which no stage list loads: in the emulator the slot holds the title sprites (p15:$A745). Drawn for one frame in stage 4 (coverage map_04 50/5, 50/8).

Sprites that exist only on screens (title cursor and logo shadow p15:$A745 / p10:$8172, take-off exhaust, radar marks of the planet choice, planet ring of the story, ending ship) are in the screen captures only; their generator sets are saved (sprgen/title_p15_A745.bin, sprgen/star_*.bin).

Char-drawn objects are proven by their RAM records (type present while the frame is logged); the name table was not compared cell by cell with the stage map, so a char drawing that is neither map nor catalogued object would not be detected.
THE PREDICTION chapters 1 and 2 and result 4 were not met; "IN THE RUIN OF LATIS" (crystal, step 2) is cut short by the autofire.
EXTEND PLAY? answered Y (list p03:$B6DC) not captured (only the time-out / SO LONG! path).
Japanese texts captured only for the attract story (run S6); interludes, item results and endings were captured with the English BIOS only.
The join needs clock mode 5 (item 5, two players) with the ships within 8x16 (p02:$9837); run S3 set 0xE630 = 5 and moved ship 2 onto ship 1, the join itself is the game code.
Run S4 kept 0xE30A (Crystal Breeze flag) at 0 from the stage-6 savestate; without Nemesis 2 the same branch of p10:$8F7F is taken.
Stage 7 events come from the Nemesis 2 cartridge data (p01:$6E44); turret 0x01 stage-7 shapes are from p02:$81AE column 7 and the emulator, not from that event list.
